France + Ireland · 2022–June 2025

About this explorer
Public metadata preview. This page shows counts, newspaper distribution, dates and dictionary flags. It contains no article text. The team reading copy is shared separately.

A data-centre article contains at least one matching term. A theme is “nearby” when one of its dictionary terms falls within 500 characters of a data-centre mention. Each article counts once per theme; categories can overlap.

Search help
Boolean mode searches the whole article in this team copy. Use uppercase AND, OR, NOT, parentheses and quoted phrases. A multiword term is treated as a phrase. Accents and case are ignored; plural forms still need separate terms. AND requires all terms in one article; use OR for spelling or language alternatives.

Actors and co-mentions

About actor analysis

Explore named people and organisations with French/English entity recognition and an editable actor dictionary. All filters above apply here. A connection means actors were mentioned together; it does not establish cooperation, influence, agreement or a speaking role.

The initial view uses dictionary identities. Include unreviewed NER candidates to discover additional actors; model errors and unresolved names remain. Generic references such as “the government” are not resolved automatically.
